report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: sampled checkout traces all return 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres, and order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with no 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No current evidence substantiates a bounded root cause; hand off for further data.
missing_evidence: Error-bearing checkout/order traces or logs showing non-2xx responses during the incident window
Order service logs (excluded from context) to confirm or rule out error signatures
Time-series of order error rates and latency over a longer window to detect a transient fault
Deployment history with a version change preceding the alleged errors
